name: Šobes

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Seasons this cool ripen Müller-Thurgau, Gewürztraminer, Riesling and Pinot Gris fully without cooking off their freshness.
Riesling, Müller-Thurgau and Gewürztraminer sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Sauvignon Blanc is at its cool limit. In cool years it can stay underripe, with green, sharp flavors.
Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

soil.rock: Granite weathers to coarse, acid, free-draining soil that warms quickly and holds heat. Its acidity tends to lower the grapes' acidity, which suits Gamay.
soil.top: The topsoil drains well and still stores water for dry spells, so vines grow evenly. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Much of it is steep. Cold air and rain run off, so frost and waterlogging are rare and soils stay thin, keeping yields low. Steep rows are slow and costly to work, often by hand.

winkler: Only very early grapes ripen well, mostly hybrids and a few vinifera.
